title: Marca Corporativa
description: O Sporting Clube de Portugal é um dos denominados três grandes do desporto português. No momento da fundação do Clube, em 1906, José Alvalade proferiu o célebre voto “Queremos que o Sporting seja um grande Clube, tão grande como os maiores da Europa”. A sua ambição representou sempre, ao longo desta história centenária, uma meta permanente no horizonte de todos os Sportinguistas e frequentemente atingida, tanto por fantásticas equipas como por atletas verdadeiramente excepcionais. Marca única, a fazer história desde 1906, repleta de grandes conquistas e na vanguarda, desde o futebol de formação, até ao relacionamento com o seu principal activo, os sportinguistas. A forma de existir do Clube ganha vida nos seus sócios e adeptos. Com mais de 3.5 milhões de simpatizantes apenas no território nacional e mais de 157 mil sócios, o Sporting Clube de Portugal assume a sua dimensão verdadeiramente mundial quando se olha para os 263 Núcleos, 124 Filiais e 23 Delegações espalhados pelos cinco continentes. O principal objetivo do Sporting Clube de Portugal são as vitórias em todas as competições que disputa, contribuindo assim para dar as maiores alegrias a todo o Universo Sportinguista. Oferta – Estágio Profissional | Marca Corporativa – Lisboa O Sporting Clube de Portugal está no mercado à procura de um Estagiário de Marca Corporativa (M/F), para integrar a Direcção de Marca e Canais de Atendimento. Perfil Licenciatura em Marketing, Comunicação, Publicidade ou similares; Perfil até 1 ano de experiência profissional; Experiência prévia em funções semelhantes, em contexto empresarial/corporate; Perfil organizado, comunicativo, dinâmico e operacional. title: Professional Internship 2026
description: A EDP é um grupo global de energia organizada em cinco regiões do mundo: Iberia, Europa, América do Norte, América do Sul e Ásia-Pacífico, com particular destaque para as energias renováveis. Com mais de 45 anos de experiência, tem vindo a consolidar uma presença relevante no panorama energético mundial, assente no compromisso de ser “all-green” até 2030, liderando a transição energética. Com mais de 13.000 colaboradores em todo o mundo, está empenhada em utilizar a sua energia e coração para impulsionar um amanhã melhor. A EDP está a liderar a mudança para um futuro mais promissor, com a energia solar no centro da sua estratégia. Desde casas alimentadas por sistemas solares até à redução das emissões de CO2, compromete-se a investir 40% do seu plano de negócios em iniciativas solares, fazendo a diferença na luta contra as alterações climáticas. Fornece eletricidade e gás a mais de 9 milhões de clientes e considera que as energias renováveis são a chave para um planeta mais sustentável. A EDP Comercial é uma empresa do Grupo EDP que atua no mercado livre de energia. Possui um sistema integrado de gestão de qualidade, ambiente e segurança, certificado pela LRQA de acordo com as normas ISO 9001:2015 , ISO 14001:2015 e ISO 45001:2018, aplicáveis à comercialização de produtos e serviços. Possui também uma medalha de platina atribuída pela ECOVADIS, colocando a organização entre as 1% melhores empresas avaliadas em sustentabilidade por esta entidade. title: Trainee Construction & Energy – Carnaxide, Lisboa

Nas suas lojas, os clientes têm uma experiência de compra simples, rápida e diferenciadora, já que encontram tudo o que precisam e muito mais, com a garantia de elevada frescura e melhor qualidade ao melhor preço. No desenvolvimento da sua gama de produtos tem em conta critérios ecológicos e sustentáveis bastante alargados. A ALDI é a empresa Discount mais bem-sucedida internacionalmente. O Santander está à procura de um(a) estagiário/a de GenAI para Lisboa.

Procuramos talento com interesse em desenvolvimento de software e inteligência artificial para integrar a nossa equipa de GenAI. O foco será o desenvolvimento de aplicações e microserviços que utilizam modelos de AI generativa pré-treinados (como os da OpenAI) para resolver desafios reais de negócio. Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para aplicar conhecimentos técnicos em projetos inovadores com impacto direto.

- Desenvolver aplicações e microserviços que integrem modelos de GenAI via APIs.

- Garantir boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo testes, versionamento e integração contínua. 
- Explorar novas ferramentas e abordagens para melhorar a eficiência e a qualidade das soluções desenvolvidas.

As nossas pessoas são a nossa maior força. Cada indivíduo contribui com perspetivas únicas que nos tornam mais fortes como equipa e como organização.

title: International Logistics Coordinator
description:
Your supply chain spans four continents. Your systems never lie. You flag a delay before anyone asks. — If that sounds like you, Brolutions is looking for an International Logistics Coordinator to own our end-to-end supply chain and keep sustainable products moving from factory to shelf. 


Remote | Full-time | Long-term | Freelance 


#JobOpening #Logistics #SupplyChain #3PL #InternationalFreight #Sustainability #Brussels 
 
About the Company 


Brolutions is a Belgian holding company behind three purpose-driven consumer brands: Bambaw (sustainable everyday products), Oravix (oral care), and Arista (Ayurveda-inspired wellness). Our products reach customers in over 30 countries through Amazon, retail, and our own webshops. We’re a compact, international team of 30 based in Brussels and remote. 


About the Role 
We’re looking for an International Logistics Coordinator to take full ownership of our physical supply chain — from the moment goods leave our suppliers in China to the moment they’re available in every regional fulfilment channel. You’ll be the central point of contact for our freight forwarders and 3PL warehouses (including Amazon FBA/AWD) across four regions (EU, UK, USA, Canada). 


This is not a support role. You’ll run logistics independently from day one, working closely with the Procurement team and reporting to the Supply Chain Manager. You’ll coordinate international freight, manage 3PL relationships and inbound shipments, keep inventory systems accurate, validate invoices, and flag risks before they become stock-outs. 


Key Responsibilities 


International Freight & Forwarding (30%) 

- Own the end-to-end shipment flow from China-based forwarders through sea/air freight to destination warehouses in EU, UK, USA, and Canada 
- Coordinate booking, documentation, customs clearance, and last-mile delivery to each 3PL 
- Track every shipment in real time and escalate delays before they impact stock availability 


Fulfilment Channel Inbound (incl. Amazon FBA/AWD) (20%) 

- Manage marketplace inbound shipments (primarily Amazon FBA) across four regions, ensuring shipment plans comply with Amazon requirements (labelling, packaging, appointment scheduling) 
- Coordinate AWD (Amazon Warehousing & Distribution) in the USA, including bulk inbound planning and auto-replenishment monitoring to FBA 
- Prepare and monitor AWD expansion to Europe when activated 


3PL Warehouse Operations (25%) 

- Serve as single point of contact for 3PLs (EU hub and E-commerce warehouse) 
- Coordinate inbound receiving, outbound dispatch, intra-warehouse transfers, and new-product onboarding at each 3PL 
- Oversee annual stock counts, review and validate 3PL invoices against agreed rate cards 


Inventory & System Accuracy (15%) 

- Keep systems consistently up to date: ERP/inventory tool, Amazon Seller Central dashboards, and the internal shipment tracking spreadsheet 
- Flag and resolve discrepancies (overstock, defectives, phantom stock) within 48 hours of detection 
- Manage product version transitions across warehouses to minimise mixed inventory 


Cost Tracking & Risk Management (10%) 

- Track logistics costs per shipment and per unit across all lanes and 3PLs; validate every invoice before approval 
- Proactively flag risks: port congestion, carrier delays, customs holds, seasonal capacity constraints 
- Maintain a shipment tracker visible to stakeholders with real-time status on every active movement 
About You 

- 2–5 years of experience in international logistics, supply chain, or freight coordination — ideally in an e-commerce or 3PL-managed environment 
- Digitally fluent: comfortable spending full days working with Office 365, online platforms, and digital coordination tools. This is a desk-based coordination role, not a field or warehouse role 
- Strong attention to detail and a personal commitment to data accuracy — you understand that a missed update in the system has downstream consequences on physical goods 
- Proactive communicator: you flag issues early with clear context rather than waiting to be asked 
- Able to juggle multiple shipments, systems, and time zones simultaneously without losing track 
- You communicate clearly in English (our working language) and flag problems early rather than waiting for them to escalate 


Nice to have: 

- Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central, FBA, or AWD inbound flows — a strong plus given the volume we ship through Amazon 
- Experience with freight documentation (bills of lading, packing lists, commercial invoices) 
- Hands-on experience with an ERP or inventory management tool 


Why Join Brolutions 

- Own the full Amazon logistics function for a brand with 800+ SKUs across four major marketplaces 
- Work with a team that values autonomy — you will run your domain, not wait for approvals 
- Be part of a sustainability-driven company where your work has real environmental impact 
- Competitive freelance compensation 
- Fully remote setup with a collaborative, international team

title: Cabin Crew Assessment Day – Lisbon – 17 June 2026
description:
Description

Would you like to be part of the Ryanair Group’s amazing cabin crew family of 16k+ crew? If you are customer-oriented, love delivering great service & want fast-track career opportunities, we would be delighted to hear from you! No experience is required, just bags of enthusiasm & team spirit!

We are currently recruiting for Cabin Crew positions for one of our many bases and would be delighted to meet you at one of our In-Person Recruitment Days!

Date: 17 June 2026

You will be invited to attend once your application has been reviewed.

As Europe’s largest airline group carrying over 600K guests on over 3,600 daily flights, we are looking for the next generation of cabin crew to join us in the Autumn/Winter months at one of our 90+ operational bases. Flying on board Ryanair Group aircraft there are some amazing perks, including; discounted staff travel to over 250+ destinations across the Ryanair network, a fixed roster pattern, free training & industry-leading pay.

Your journey to becoming a qualified cabin crew member will start on a 6-week training course where you will learn all of the fundamental skills that you will require as part of your day-to-day role delivering a top-class safety & customer service experience to our guests. During the course you will be required to study with exams taking place at regular intervals, the training culminates with Supernumerary flights, followed by your Cabin Crew Wings.

As a member of the Ryanair Group cabin crew family, you will be immersed into our culture from day one, the career opportunities are endless including becoming a number 1, base supervisor, Regional Manager or why not aspire to becoming our Director of Inflight?

Life as Cabin Crew is fun & rewarding, it is however a demanding position where safety is our number 1 priority. You will be required to operate both early & late shifts & report for duty as early as 5 am in the morning on the early roster & not return home until midnight on the afternoon roster. If you are not a morning person, then think twice before applying!

Some of our amazing benefits;



- Free Internationally recognised Cabin Crew Training Course
- Daily per Diem whilst training – €28 per day
- Uncapped Sales bonus
- Unlimited highly discounted Staff Travel
- Fixed roster pattern
- The adventure and experience of a lifetime within our Cabin Crew network
- Explore new cultures and cities with colleagues on your days off
- Free Uniform in Year 1 and annual allowance afterwards
- Security of working for a financially stable Airline

Requirements



- Applicants must hold the unrestricted right to live and work in the EU and travel freely throughout the Ryanair Network
- You must approximately be between 5 “2 (157 cm) and 6” 2 (188 cm) in height.
- You must be able to swim 25 meters unaided.
- It helps if you are hardworking, flexible and have an outgoing and friendly personality.
- Adaptable and happy to work a shift roster.
- Enjoy dealing with the public and have the ability to provide excellent customer service with a ‘can do’ attitude.
- Comfortable speaking and writing in English with ease.
- A passion for travelling and meeting new people.

title: Housekeeper
description:
If you are an internal applicant, please log into Workday and submit your application via the Jobs Hub. Please click here to apply internally.

This role will be located at one of Discovery Land Company’s locations: Costa Terra, set outside of Melides - Comporta.

Costa Terra is seeking a Housekeeper to join the Residential Services Department.

The Housekeeper is responsible for maintaining a clean, orderly, and inviting environment within our prestigious residential community. You will ensure that the clubhouse, public areas, amenities facilities, and private residential homes are well-maintained, presentable, and exceeds the expectations of members and guests. You will work closely with the Residential Services and Club Operations management team to deliver exceptional service and uphold the highest standards of cleanliness and sanitation. In this role, you will be part of creating the Discovery Land Company experience for our members and fellow employees.

Key Responsibilities

Housekeeper



- Clean Offices, Wc, Kitchen and outdoor areas
- Clean and organize the fridge
- Clean Coffee machines and toasters
- Clean air conditioners whenever necessary
- Clean bathrooms and restock with soap and paper products if needed.
- Vacuum carpeted areas and sweep, scrub and mop floors.
- Clean kitchens including wash dishes and others
- Clean the bins
- Empties and relines all trash containers.
- Cleans glass on windows and doors.
- Dust furniture, pictures, window ledges and shelves.
- Detail cleaning including ceilings, vents, light fixtures, walls, room high and low corners, sky lights, door sills, door tops, tops of decorative and operational furniture.
- Maintain confidentiality.
- Submit billing for work completed to management.
- Other duties assigned by management.

Qualifications



- High School Diploma or equivalent.
- At least 6 months of previous housekeeping experience preferred.
- Proven experience in professional cleaning or housekeeping, preferably in a high-end residential or hospitality setting.
- Excellent knowledge of cleaning products, techniques, and best practices for maintaining cleanliness and hygiene.
- Knowledge of health and safety regulations and the ability to apply them in the workplace.
- Safety conscious at all times in use of machinery and chemicals to avoid injury to self and others.
- Attention to detail and the ability to maintain a high standard of cleanliness throughout the clubhouse.
- Must have a valid Driver’s License

Additional Requirements



- Positive attitude, professional demeanor, and exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to deliver service to members, guests, and team members.
- Must be able to work flexible work hours/schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Long hours may be required due to business demands.
- Ability to work in a team environment.
- Ability to stay calm and focused during the busiest of times.
- Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English; additional languages preferred.
- Ability to meet the physical demands of the position including, but not limited to, working indoors and outdoors in all weather conditions, standing, walking, and moving for periods of greater than eight (8) hours, and lifting and carrying items sometimes greater than 25 kgs.

What do we offer?

Work-Family Culture, Global Career Opportunities, Competitive Salarys, Development Programs, Medical Insurance, Meal Allowance, Staff Restaurant, Staff Events and Staff accommodation if you are not local.

If you have what it takes and want to build a career , this is the place for you!

About Us

Costaterra Golf & Ocean Club is part of DLC – Discovery Land Company (DLC). DLC is known for developing luxury residential communities and resorts.

Costaterra is a private members only residential community in Comporta – Portugal. It combines luxury living with top-tier hospitality, offering incredible dining, a world-class golf course, spa services, outdoor pursuits, and immersive local experiences.

title: Document Controller
description:
Rockland Concrete - About Us


Rockland Concrete is a specialist manufacturer and supplier of ready-mix concrete, delivering innovative and flexible solutions through a nationwide network of mobile on-site batching plants. Operating across the UK, the company supports a wide range of construction and infrastructure projects by providing high-quality concrete production directly at the point of use.


This position is bases in Sines, Portugal.


Main Duties and Responsibilities for the Document Controller:



- Coordination of all activities related to the Document Control procedure, including technical documents, drawings, and commercial correspondence.
- Technical management of document control system/platform (ACC and Procore)
- Quality Assurance check of submitted documentation according to TSP/Client standard
- Monitor due dates of drawings and technical submittal according to milestones
- Management of Request For Information status
- Control the creation and approval of project documents including management of the workflow set-up
- Management of As-built documents with Project/Design team
- Exercise version control where multiple versions of a document are maintained
- Manage storage of documents in a way that facilitates convenient retrieval of a particular document when needed.
- Ensure security and safety of documents with the dual objectives of preventing unauthorized access to documents and allowing recovery from physical damage or loss of documents.
- Generate the various document control reports as required.
- Archive old documents and disposing them at the end of their life.
- Development of document control system
- Reporting review of new document control tools, programs, and platforms




Skills and Experience Required for the Document Controller:



- Experience within a document controller role
- Experience of working with Aconex or a document control system
- Excellent attention to detail and organisation skills
- Good team player
- Strong ability to communicate effectively at all levels.

title: Marketing Representative
description:
Marketing Representative


Are you a creative thinker with a passion for marketing and a knack for driving sales? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a significant impact in the airline industry? Join our team at Turkish Airlines, where we value innovative ideas and strive to reach new heights in our marketing and sales efforts.


As a Sales-Driven Marketing Representative, you will play a key role in conducting insightful market research, developing effective sales strategies, and evaluating marketing processes to drive success. If you're ready to bring your creativity, analytical skills, and friendly demeanor to a dynamic team focused on driving sales, this role is perfect for you. Come join us and be part of our journey to inspire and captivate audiences with our exceptional services!


Job Accountabilities:



- To achieve agreed sales revenue targets by developing and maintaining business/relationships with travel agencies and their respective clients.
- To closely monitor area sales performance and recommend actions where necessary to maximise revenue, share and loyalty.
- Ensure the Sales Managers are kept well informed of assigned portfolio performance, market feedback, conditions, trends and competitor activities and make recommendations as appropriate to protect the overall interest and the profitability of the airline.
- Create action plans to present to the Sales Manager based on market needs and feedback, competitor’s activities and subsequently assist in designing and developing the sales and marketing strategies for the territory to ensure growth in revenue and market share for TK.
- To actively visit both travel agency and corporate clients on the required call frequency basis.
- To actively engage with clients within portfolio and maintain the required calls frequency basis to build and maintain strong commercial relationships, and maintain necessary records, including sales call visits, topics discussed, agreements achieved.
- Promote & position TK corporate and leisure products including special segments (marine, humanitarian, cruise, student, MICE).
- To act as an ambassador for the company and attend industry functions, trade events, conferences and familiarization trips to establish contacts, network and promote the interests of TK in and out of office hours as required.
- To negotiate agreements with corporate clients and review/assess performance.
- To account manage all activity with corporate travel agencies and ensure the effective dissemination and communication of TK developments to assigned clients.
- To conduct TK product training as required to ensure that assigned agencies are kept up to date with all TK products/services.


Qualifications:



- Minimum Bachelor's degree (Master's degree preferred).
- At least 2 years of relevant experience in civil aviation or tourism.
- Excellent command of English and Portuguese.
- Valid work permit or citizenship in the respective country (we are unable to provide or assist with work permits).
- A team player who can also work independently when necessary.
- Proficiency in MS Office products and other relevant informatics tools.


Benefits:

- Ticket Rights
- Travel Allowance


We strive to bring the far close by making the world move through our wings. We are working with all our strengths to offer our guests a unique experience while connecting 350 destinations around the world. We would like to see you among us in our success story to which each member of our family contributes. Now it is time to grow our family with you to achieve greater goals.

description:
Carga de trabajo: 100%

Tipo de contrato: Posición permanente

Modalidad: Trabajo remoto (home office)

Sobre nosotros

ASSPA es un corredor financiero especializado en créditos y seguros con sede en Suiza. Trabajamos en colaboración con los principales bancos del país y atendemos principalmente a clientes hispanohablantes (latinos y españoles) que viven y trabajan en Suiza.

El puesto

Buscamos asesores(as) comerciales / teleoperadores(as) independientes, para realizar el primer contacto con nuestros clientes, brindar información introductoria y registrar sus datos. Dado que nuestro equipo está distribuido geográficamente, este trabajo se realiza desde casa.

Nuestra propuesta

Nos enfocamos en ofrecer a cada cliente una propuesta personalizada, ya sea para créditos o seguros, asegurando siempre las mejores condiciones disponibles en el mercado. Nuestra fortaleza radica en saber ubicar estratégicamente los servicios según la institución financiera que mejor se adapte a cada situación.
Tareas

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades en este puesto?

– Motivar a los prospectos a trabajar contigo y, gracias a tu habilidad en ventas, convertir su interés en resultados reales.

– Te comunicarás en español con personas que ya dejaron sus datos en nuestra web. No harás llamadas en frío: los contactos ya esperan que los llamemos para recibir información.

– Recopilar la información necesaria de cada cliente e ingresarla correctamente en nuestra base de datos electrónica (CRM).

– Generar confianza y credibilidad durante el primer contacto para convertir prospectos en clientes duraderos.

– Completar la documentación requerida para cada cliente.

– Hacer seguimiento y mantener una relación activa con los clientes existentes (servicio postventa y atención al cliente).
Requisitos

🟡 ¿A quién buscamos?

¿Tienes al menos 2 años de experiencia comprobada en ventas y hablas francés con soltura? Entonces esta posición es para ti.

Buscamos una persona con:

✅ Dominio del francés oral y escrito (nivel B2 o superior – excluyente)

✅ Mínimo 2 años de experiencia comprobable en ventas, idealmente en banca, seguros o servicios financieros

✅ Español nativo (excluyente)

✅ Talento natural para conectar por teléfono: voz segura, clara y espontánea

✅ Habilidades destacadas de comunicación, persuasión y escucha activa

✅ Buen nivel de organización, responsabilidad y atención al detalle

✅ Manejo básico/intermedio de herramientas informáticas

✅ Residencia en Portugal (excluyente)
Beneficios

💰 Ingresos variables atractivos, directamente vinculados a tus resultados: a mejor desempeño, mayores ingresos.

🎯 Comisiones ilimitadas por cada venta concretada y bonificaciones adicionales al cumplir objetivos.

🤝 Objetivos claros y alcanzables, con acompañamiento constante para apoyarte.

🌍 100% remoto — trabaja desde casa o desde cualquier lugar.

🚀 Sin techo de ingresos — tú decides cuánto ganas según tu dedicación y resultados.

📅 Fines de semana libres — disfruta tu tiempo personal sin interrupciones.

🛑 Importante: Por favor, no postules si no cumples con estos requisitos. Este puesto requiere formación y experiencia comprobable en ventas telefónicas. Queremos asegurarnos de que esta oportunidad sea adecuada para ti desde el inicio.

title: Estágio | Experience Design

description:
ESTÁGIO — GESTÃO DE REDES SOCIAIS E CRIAÇÃO DE CONTEÚDOS
Museu da Independência [Portugal 900 Anos] · Lisboa
Sobre o projeto
O Museu da Independência [Portugal 900 Anos] é um novo projeto cultural que abrirá ao
público em novembro de 2026, no Palácio da Independência — Monumento Nacional
situado no Largo de São Domingos, no coração de Lisboa. Foi neste edifício que, em 1640,
os Quarenta Conjurados planearam a Restauração da Independência de Portugal.
O Museu propõe uma viagem pelos 900 anos da história de Portugal e pretende posicionar-
se como destino cultural de referência em Lisboa, com uma programação que inclui
exposições, tertúlias, concertos e atividades educativas.
O que procuramos
Procuramos 1 a 2 estagiários(as) para integrar a equipa de comunicação do Museu durante
a fase de lançamento. O estágio é uma oportunidade única de construir, desde o zero, a
presença digital de um museu nacional — e de acompanhar todo o processo, da ativação
das redes à cobertura da inauguração.
Responsabilidades
• Criar e gerir conteúdos para Instagram, Facebook e TikTok (publicações regulares,
stories, reels)
• Produzir conteúdos visuais: fotografia, vídeo curto, design gráfico (Canva, CapCut
ou equivalente)
• Apoiar o lançamento do site institucional e da newsletter mensal
• Cobrir eventos e bastidores do Museu para publicação nas redes sociais
• Monitorizar métricas de engagement e preparar relatórios de desempenho
Museu da Independência · Kit de Candidatura a Estágios
SHIP · Palácio da Independência · Documento de trabalho · Maio 2026
• Apoiar a campanha de comunicação da pré-inauguração e inauguração
• Articular com fotógrafo, designer e outros fornecedores externos
Perfil
• Licenciatura ou mestrado (concluído ou em conclusão) em Comunicação, Marketing,
Multimédia, Design de Comunicação, Historia ou áreas afins
• Experiência (mesmo pessoal) na gestão de contas de Instagram e/ou TikTok
• Domínio de ferramentas de criação de conteúdo: Canva, CapCut, Premiere,
Photoshop ou equivalentes
• Boa capacidade de escrita em português; inglês fluente (valorizado)
• Interesse por história, cultura e património
• Proatividade, sentido estético e atenção ao detalhe
• Conhecimentos de fotografia e/ou vídeo com smartphone (valorizado)
Condições
• Tipo: estágio (curricular, profissional IEFP ou extracurricular)
• Duração: 6 a 9 meses (setembro 2026 – março 2027)
• Horário: tempo completo ou parcial (a combinar), com flexibilidade
• Local: Palácio da Independência, Rossio, Lisboa (com possibilidade de trabalho
remoto parcial)
• Bolsa: [indicar valor, se aplicável] / Estágio ATIVAR comparticipado pelo IEFP
• Transportes: acessível por metro (Rossio), autocarro e comboio
O que oferecemos
• Participação num projeto cultural único — lançamento de um museu nacional, do
zero
• Contacto direto com a direção da SHIP e com a equipa de recuperação do
património
• Experiência profissional em comunicação institucional e gestão de redes sociais em
contexto museológico
• Portfolio: todo o conteúdo produzido pode ser usado pelo(a) estagiário(a) como
portfolio
• Certificado de estágio e carta de recomendação
• Trabalhar num Monumento Nacional classificado, com jardins e vista sobre Lisboa
Candidatura

- Enviar CV e portfolio (ou link para redes sociais pessoais) para [ana.proserpio@sociedadehistorica.pt].

title: Sales Assistant, Amoreiras Store -30h-
description:
A Scalpers nasceu e cresceu como uma marca voltada para a moda masculina. Depois de se lançar como menino em 2012, como mulher em 2018 e como menina em 2019, a marca tornou-se um dos principais operadores espanhóis de varejo de moda com grande reconhecimento internacional.

Após 18 anos de experiência, a Scalpers consolidou-se como empresa e está presente em mais de 7 países com mais de 300 pontos de venda internacionalmente e uma força de trabalho de mais de 1.500 colaboradores.

Continuamos a crescer?
Procuramos pessoal para nosso ponto de venda na Amoreiras Shopping. Jornada de 30 horas semanais. Contrato por tempo indeterminado.

A moda é a sua paixão, tem criatividade, sabe ouvir os clientes e gosta do nosso produto? Estamos à sua espera!

O seu principal objetivo será representar os valores e a imagem da marca. Além disso, criará uma experiência para os nossos clientes, cumprindo os objetivos da loja, mantendo a ordem e a reposição do produto.

A nossa missão

«Que as pessoas voltem às nossas lojas e sejam mais rebeldes»

Queres juntar-te à equipa para alcançarmos esse objetivo?

Requisitos

Criamos moda versátil, com coleções que pode usar desde logo pela manhã para ir trabalhar, para se encontrar com os seus amigos, viajar, praticar desporto e para ficar em casa, sem nunca perder o conforto. Por isso, sabemos adaptar-nos às necessidades de cada pessoa.

O que vai precisar?



- Ser uma pessoa orientada para a moda e que gosta de estar a par das tendências.


Atrair e fidelizar o cliente, prestando atenção a cada detalhe e com conhecimento do produto, para obter resultados de faturação e atingir os objetivos e KPIs.



- Realizar tarefas operacionais, inventários (sistema RFID), receção de guias de remessa, reposição da loja, etc.

- Manter a imagem da loja seguindo os padrões visuais, bem como a ordem da mesma.

- Trabalhar em equipa, manter e cuidar de um ambiente positivo, entusiasta, proativo e flexível.


O que oferecemos?

BENEFÍCIOS: aceda a programas de reconhecimento e recompensas que fazem com que o seu esforço valha ainda mais a pena.

OPORTUNIDADES DE CRESCIMENTO: se a sua paixão é o mundo da moda, aqui encontrará um caminho repleto de possibilidades para crescer, desenvolver-se e até mesmo viajar pelo mundo.

CULTURA E AMBIENTE DE TRABALHO: junte-se a uma equipa dinâmica, criativa e colaborativa. Na Scalpers, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade para aprender, contribuir e fazer as coisas acontecerem.

PROPÓSITO E VALOR: na Scalpers, somos movidos pela qualidade, criatividade e sustentabilidade, trabalhamos em equipa para oferecer experiências únicas aos nossos clientes.

O MUNDO PRECISA DE MAIS REBELDES, JUNTE-SE A NÓS!

AVISO

A SCALPERS publica as suas ofertas de emprego apenas no seu próprio portal, nos sites InfoJobs e FashionJobs, e no seu próprio LinkedIn, alertando expressamente os utilizadores de que não se responsabiliza pelas ofertas de emprego publicadas em qualquer outro portal web, que podem constituir uma fraude para os candidatos.

title: Customer Success Associate
description:
About The Company

Ethiack is pioneering agentic AI pentesting. Why should you join us?



- Variety: No two weeks look the same
- Impact: Your work drives real results
- Growth: We're scaling fast. There's room to grow within the business
- Culture: We value transparency, ethics, synergy, and trust (T.E.S.T.)
- Autonomy: We give you clear direction, then trust you to own your work
- Mission: We're securing technology and the people who rely on it.

About The Role

Role Overview:

You'll be primary point of contact of a portfolio of customer accounts, support their day-to-day questions, and make sure every interaction with Ethiack feels easy and human. It's a role with real ownership, real mentorship, and a clear path to grow into a CSM or Support Lead.

Responsibilities



- Be the first point of contact for customer questions and incidents, and route the trickier ones cleanly to our Tier 2 teams.
- Own your customer portfolio end-to-end, from onboarding to business reviews and renewals.
- Help customers get the most out of Ethiack, spotting friction early and turning it into upsell and expansion opportunities.
- Keep our knowledge base and playbooks fresh, so every customer gets a faster answer than the last.

Requirements



- 1–3 years in a customer-facing role (Support, CSM, Account Management, or similar).
- Excellent communication in Portuguese and English.
- Empathy, active listening, and a genuine love for helping people.
- Organized, reliable, and comfortable juggling multiple accounts.
- Curious. About people, tech, and the cybersecurity world.

Perks



- Opportunities for career progression and the chance to progress within the company as we grow.
- Supportive environment for personal and professional growth, where your contributions truly make an impact.
- A dynamic, agile work environment where your contributions lead to tangible impact.
- Flexible hybrid work arrangement.
- Provided MacBook, monitor, and other essential tools.
- Health Insurance.
- Engaging work culture, including quarterly team-building events.

If you love taking care of customers and want to grow alongside a team that genuinely cares back, we'd love to meet you. Come build something meaningful with us at Ethiack!

By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

title: Nutrition & Community Assistant - Trainee (BR Market · PT-based)
description:
Welcome to Nutrium

Before you apply, here’s the key thing: our mission is to promote global well-being by making quality 1:1 nutrition accessible to everyone.

A lot has changed since we started, but our mission is still at the heart of everything we do: it’s written in our culture book, in our proposals, in our docs, and it guides every decision we make.

It’s also what allowed us, for years, to improve the experience of nutrition professionals and their patients through the world’s #1 nutrition counseling platform. But we didn’t stop there.

Today, with Nutrium Care, we’re taking the next step: bringing real, personalized nutrition to people anytime, anywhere, and helping them build healthier, happier lives.

Along the way, we raised our Series A and surpassed €15M in funding, partnered with global leaders like Wellhub, Suzano, Vodafone, Adidas, and Linde, and reached millions of people around the world.

From day one, we also knew something else: building this future would take more than great tech. It would take a place where talented people can grow, feel supported, and enjoy the journey along the way.

You go first

We're proud of our journey so far, and we believe there's space for more people to shine, challenge us, and help shape what comes next.

⭐ What You Will Bring

As a Nutrition and Community Assistant (Trainee), you will help us grow our network of Brazilian nutritionists, support their day-to-day, organize the activities that keep our community engaged, and bring your clinical know-how into the product itself.

This is a hands-on role that calls for strong clinical foundations, curiosity, attention to detail, and a real passion for nutrition.

⭐ What You Will Be Doing



- Support Brazilian nutritionists and patients, ensuring a smooth and trustworthy experience throughout the program;
- Organize webinars and engagement activities to keep the Nutrium Care community active and connected;
- Support the team in recruiting and onboarding Brazilian nutritionists for the Nutrium Care provider network;
- Support the review of nutritional information available on the Nutrium software and mobile app;
- Translate clinical nutrition concepts to our product and technical teams, helping them build features that truly serve nutritionists in practice;
- Collaborate in the integration of scientific information and content into the software;
- Support the production of nutrition education content for patients and the wider community.

⭐ You might be a great fit if you...



- Hold a Bachelor's degree in Nutrition Sciences, with academic equivalence recognized in Portugal;
- Are based in Portugal and meet the eligibility criteria for a professional internship (IEFP);
- Are a strong communicator, comfortable explaining clinical concepts to non-clinical audiences;
- Are organized, detail-oriented, and able to juggle multiple priorities;
- Have a genuine interest in digital health and how technology can scale clinical nutrition;
- Are a native or fluent Brazilian Portuguese speaker;
- Have basic English skills to collaborate with our international team;
- Are proactive, curious, and eager to learn in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

Now, it's our turn

Transparency is one of our core values, so here's exactly what you can expect from Nutrium:

Perks and benefits:



- Unlimited nutritional appointments (via Nutrium Care)
- Unlimited psychology sessions
- Meal allowance: 10,46€ per working day
- Professional development budget
- A multicultural team that enjoys spending time together, not just while working, but also through team activities, social events, and our annual offsite.

🚀 How We'll Get To Know Each Other

A quick overview of what our hiring journey looks like:



- CV Screening
- First interview with the recruiter
- Challenge
- Final interview

We're committed to making our hiring process fair, inclusive, and human.

We aim to build a team that reflects the diversity of the world we live in. That means welcoming people of all races, ethnicities, genders, sexual orientations, ages, abilities, religions, and backgrounds.

If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You might be exactly who we're looking for.

A note on our hiring process

We want our interviewers focused on you. To help with that, interviews may be recorded via Teamtailor Meet, with the support of AI note-taking tools.

If you'd prefer not to be recorded, just let us know before the interview begins. This won't change anything about how we assess you.

title: Recrutador
Assistente administrativo de RH
Data Analyst and communication expert (m/f/div.)
description:
Company Description

The Keenfinity Group delivers professional communication and security solutions that connect and protect people and assets. Following its carve-out from the Bosch Group in mid-2025, it operates as independent company within the portfolio of European investment firm Triton. The Group’s four Businesses include Audio delivering professional communication products of the globally renowned brands Bosch, Electro-Voice, Dynacord, RTS and Telex, IQSIGHT Video Systems, Radionix Intrusion & Access, and KEENFINITY Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS). In fiscal year 2025, the group generated revenues of over €1 billion and employed approximately 4,000 people across more than 40 countries.

Job Description

We are professionalizing our end‑to‑end finance processes, harmonizing SAP templates and establishing a global BPO model. In this role, you will actively shape how our future accounting landscape looks.

This hybrid role combines advanced data analytics with communication excellence. You will lead the development of modern Power BI dashboards for Finance (I2P, B2C, B2R processes) and drive internal communication that strengthens transparency, alignment, and engagement across the global organization.

Your Responsibilities



-  Power BI & Finance Analytics
- Drive the Power BI reporting initiative for Finance with focus on I2P, B2C, B2R. 
- Integrate data from SAP, Comarch ECM, and additional systems. 
- Build, automate, and maintain high‑quality dashboards and KPI landscapes. 
- Ensure data quality through validation, modeling, structuring, and governance. 
- Support the global BPO setup with data-driven insights and reporting automation. 
- Conduct ad-hoc analyses for Finance, Operations, and Management. 
- Support new BI technologies, datasets, APIs, and automation tools (Power Automate). 
-  Organizational Communication & Stakeholder Enablement
- Create clear, engaging communication about Finance organization status and improvements. 
- Translate complex processes into easy-to-understand materials (presentations, infographics, intranet pages, newsletters, LinkedIn posts if appropriate). 
- Design communication around new tools, processes, KPIs, and success stories. 
- Structure and maintain escalation paths and process explanations. 
- Prepare steering committee materials, leadership briefings, and decision papers. 
- Support workshop moderation (onsite and remote) to align global stakeholders. 
- Ensure consistent corporate messaging across M365, Intranet, SharePoint, and other channels. 

Why this role is attractive



- High visibility: your insights feed directly into management decisions. 
- Greenfield reporting landscape: build modern BI from the ground up. 
- International collaboration and true KPI ownership. 
- Opportunity to drive automation (e.g., Power BI/Power Automate). 

Qualifications



- Degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering or related field. 
- 2+ years of experience in Data Analytics, BI, or reporting. 
- Strong skills in Power BI, DAX, Power Query, and data modeling.Hands-on experience with SAP or SAP-based data models; experience with ECM (e.g. Comarch) is a plus. 
- Excellent English skills; ability to communicate complex topics simply and visually. 
- Structured, analytical, solution-oriented mindset with good storytelling capabilities.Excellent English skills. 

Nice to have



- Experience with end‑to‑end finance processes (I2P, P2P, O2C, B2C, R2R/B2R). 
- Skills in SQL, Python, R, or data automation tooling. 
- Knowledge of Data Vault, star schema, or modern data architecture. 
- Experience with M365 communication (SharePoint, Viva Engage, Teams channels, etc.). 
- Basic design skills (PowerPoint, Canva, Figma) or workshop facilitation experience. 

Legal Notes



- GDPR‑compliant handling of personal data; collection limited to job‑relevant information. 
- No collection of irrelevant private information in line with Portuguese data‑protection rules. 
- Fully non‑discriminatory posting in accordance with EU and Portuguese labor law. 

Additional Information

Keenfinity Benefits includes:

⚖️ Flexible work conditions

🔀 Hybrid work system (2 - 3 days at the office)

🧑‍⚕️ Health insurance and medical office on site (nutrition, psychology, physiotherapy and general clinic)

🍽️ Canteen

🅿️ Free parking lot

🏋️ Sports and health related activities (gym)

📚 Training opportunities (i.e., technical training, foreign languages training) & certifications

📈 Opportunities for career progression and continuous professional development

🌐 Exchange with colleagues around the world

💲 Access to great discounts in partnerships and products

🌍All our positions are open to people with disability

title: Marketing Analyst
description:
This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Marketing Analyst in Portugal.

You will join a global, data-driven environment where marketing performance and experimentation play a central role in shaping user acquisition and business growth. In this role, you will transform large-scale marketing and campaign data into actionable insights that directly influence strategy, optimization, and budget allocation. You will work closely with marketing, product, and analytics teams to evaluate campaign performance, improve attribution models, and identify opportunities to increase ROI. The position requires strong analytical thinking, a deep understanding of statistical methods, and the ability to work with complex datasets across multiple tools. You will also play a key role in designing and evaluating A/B tests, ensuring accurate measurement and continuous improvement of marketing initiatives. Operating in a fast-paced, international, and fully remote environment, you will contribute to scaling products used across global markets. This is a high-impact analytical role where your insights directly shape marketing efficiency and growth.

Accountabilities



- Prepare and deliver detailed analytical reports on marketing campaigns, identifying optimization opportunities and performance improvement strategies.
- Analyze key marketing KPIs daily, detect anomalies, and proactively investigate changes in performance trends.
- Design, monitor, and evaluate A/B tests, providing clear recommendations based on statistical outcomes and experimental results.
- Improve and maintain attribution models, LTV frameworks, and marketing performance measurement methodologies.
- Develop actionable insights to enhance campaign effectiveness, targeting strategies, and overall marketing ROI.
- Optimize reporting systems and budgeting tools to improve accuracy, efficiency, and decision-making processes.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data consistency and alignment across marketing analytics initiatives.

Requirements



- Bachelor’s degree in a technical, mathematical, economics, or related quantitative field.
- Strong knowledge of Google Sheets, including advanced functions and pivot tables.
- Solid experience with BigQuery and working with large-scale datasets.
- Strong foundation in statistical analysis and mathematical concepts relevant to marketing analytics.
- Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, Superset, or similar platforms.
- Strong English communication skills (B2+ level or higher).
- Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a distributed, remote-first environment.
- Nice to have: experience with SQL (MS SQL), basic Python, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or Google Ads platforms.
- Preferred: candidates based in APAC or nearby time zones with at least 3 hours of overlap with team working hours.

Benefits



- Fully remote work opportunity with global flexibility.
- 28 days of annual vacation plus 7 additional wellness days.
- Annual bonuses for successful employee referrals (up to $5,000).
- 50% reimbursement for professional development, training, and international conferences.
- Corporate discounts for English language learning.
- Health-related support, including up to $1,000 annual reimbursement for medical expenses or insurance.
- Home office or co-working space support, including equipment provision or reimbursement.
- Internal reward system with gamified bonuses redeemable for gifts, experiences, and team activities.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

 Why Apply Through Jobgether?

title: Intern - Social Impact Marketing
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As a member of the Social Impact marketing team, you’ll support ongoing Social Impact projects - communicating the firm’s rapidly growing commercial work on the role of business in society, as BCG helps the private sector deliver systemic solutions to the world’s biggest social and environmental problems, such a climate change, profitably. You will also focus on the firm’s work at the intersection of the private, public, and social sectors, with partners such as WWF, Save the Children, and WFP.

While this role is broad, you’ll mainly be focused on external communications and promotion of BCG thought leadership across LinkedIn and other platforms. Other responsibilities will include supporting external events and engagements, coordinating with internal teams, and working with the Global Social Impact Marketing team on an array of ad hoc projects. This well-rounded role will also support overall management activities for the Social Impact practice, again, with an emphasis on marketing and communications.

YOU’RE GOOD AT

The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated passion for and commitment to social impact; demonstrated writing experience; an active social media presence; closely follow current events; be highly organized; feel comfortable working on multiple projects and reporting to varying seniority levels simultaneously; be willing to learn what may be new technologies, including Figma, Trello, and Microsoft Dynamics; and possess excellent communication, project management, and time management skills.

What You'll Bring



- Excellent writing and verbal communication skills
- Very strong time management and project management skills
- Experience with social media channels, especially LinkedIn
- Attention to detail
- Ability to work autonomously and handle ambiguity

Who You'll Work With

The Social Impact marketing team located in Boston and London, primarily. However, you will also work with the broader Social Impact global management & operation team in addition to various senior members of the practice and global corporate marketing teams.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

description:
Oliver Wyman, a Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) business, is a management consulting firm driven by deep industry insight, bold innovation, and a collaborative approach that cuts through complexity to help organizations navigate their most defining transformative moments.




The Opportunity:


The Data and Analytics Analyst will be responsible for creating and maintaining reporting artifacts (dashboards and reports) connected to the operations of Oliver Wyman. Our ideal candidate not only understands the technical sides of reporting but is passionate about the field of analytics where they can use their problem-solving skills and creativity to uncover the “Why” for the analysis.


***PLEASE SUBMIT CVs IN ENGLISH***




Key Responsibilities:



- Partner with business stakeholders to define their reporting and analytics needs and develop solutions for delivering against them
- Assist in development and delivery of new data sets, metrics and analytics content to support business strategic decisions.
- Assist with the identification and deployment of efficiencies and enhancements in reporting and analytics
- Assist with the development, training and support of the “analytics community” to ensure awareness and proficiency on tools and available data models
- Provide support and expertise in data and analytics (data sourcing, data preparation and data visualization) to the various analytics teams in their efforts to convert their offline reporting models to the technologies available as part of the data and analytics initiative.
- Partner with technology groups (data architects) to define data requirements for business intelligence visualizations and tools
- Participate in the on-going development of the business intelligence and data warehousing functions within the wider organization




Experience Required:



- Bachelors / MS in a quantitative discipline e.g., applied mathematics, statistics, computer science, information systems, econometrics, or related field
- 3+ years of experience in business analytics and business support functions
- 3+ years of experience working with Tableau software to design, develop, and deploy business dashboards (Tableau Desktop, Tableau Server and Tableau Data Prep.)
- 3+ years of SQL/PLSQL development experience
- Experience in managing/maintaining Tableau sites and projects ensuring a consistent design, deployment, and maintenance process is followed.
- Experience in Agile delivery methodology in a data and analytics context
- Deep understanding of data warehouse processes, dimensional modeling and ETL/Integration
- Knowledge of industry standard Business Intelligence (BI) tools, such as: Oracle (OBIEE), Business Objects, etc.
- Experience with statistical programming (R, SAS, and/or Python), a plus
- Experience with multiple RMDB’s such as SQL Server, Oracle
- Strong Excel, PowerPoint skills
- English fluency (written and spoken) required




Skills and Attributes:



- Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills required
- Ability to drive exploration and draw conclusions from multiple data sets
- Strong spirit of innovation, self-starter, independent, and with ability to come up with solutions to meet business problems
- Self-directed who can interpret data to understand trends and derive meaningful business insights for senior executives with little oversight
- Self-motivated with ability to work independently while also enjoying collaboration with cross-functional teams and other analysts
- Strong desire to learn new skills and pass knowledge acquired onto others
- Keen attention to detail with deep quantitative and analytical skills and demonstrated capacity to solve problems and enhance reporting
- Strong relationship building skills and ability to build alignment among customers and key stakeholders with demonstrated experience influencing without authority
- Ability to work effectively in a fast paced, deadline driven, highly dynamic atmosphere and react quickly to changes and shifting priorities.
- Effective communication skills and ability to translate numbers into a story
- You need to be curious by nature, understand how data is produced in our various underlying systems and how reporting and analytics content is compiled so that data can be turned into actionable business insights to support the firm’s strategy.




At Oliver Wyman, a Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) business, we bring deep industry insight, bold innovation, and a collaborative approach that cuts through complexity to help organizations navigate their most defining transformative moments.


As a business of Marsh, we work alongside the world’s leading experts across risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting. Together with Marsh Risk, Guy Carpenter, and Mercer, we help organizations build resilience and competitive advantages from every angle. With annual revenue over $24 billion and more than 90,000 colleagues in 130 countries, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective.
For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

title: Quantitative Analyst
description:
This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Quantitative Analyst in Portugal.

This role sits at the intersection of quantitative research, data engineering, and analytical problem-solving within a fast-paced research environment. You will support quantitative researchers by ensuring high-quality datasets, building internal tools, and improving research workflows. The work involves deep interaction with production systems, requiring strong attention to detail and a structured approach to complex data challenges. You will contribute to the reliability and efficiency of research operations by validating data, monitoring systems, and investigating anomalies. The environment is highly technical, collaborative, and focused on continuous improvement of data-driven decision-making. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys Python-centric work and wants to contribute to real-world quantitative research without being directly involved in trading or portfolio management.

Accountabilities

In this role, you will ensure the integrity and usability of research and production data while supporting quantitative teams in their day-to-day needs. You will work closely with researchers and engineers to enhance tooling and streamline workflows.



- Discover, validate, clean, and maintain datasets used in research and production environments
- Monitor production systems, analyze logs, and investigate data or system inconsistencies
- Support ad-hoc research requests and perform exploratory data analysis when needed
- Design and build internal tools, scripts, and automation utilities using Python
- Collaborate with quantitative researchers and engineers to improve research infrastructure and operational efficiency

Requirements

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with large and complex datasets using Python. Strong problem-solving skills and curiosity for understanding systems are essential.



- Strong proficiency in Python with a focus on clean, maintainable code
- Solid experience with Pandas and NumPy for data manipulation and analysis
- Excellent attention to detail, accuracy, and code quality standards
- Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving abilities
- Ability and willingness to dive deep into complex technical systems and workflows
- No prior experience in finance or quantitative trading is required
- Background in STEM fields such as Mathematics, Computer Science, or Engineering is a plus

Benefits



- Remote-first setup with flexible working arrangements
- Provision of corporate hardware and access to a private research computing cluster
- Regular team gatherings, in-person events, and retreats
- Exposure to advanced technologies and real-world, high-scale data challenges
- Opportunity to work closely with experienced quantitative researchers and engineers

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

 Why Apply Through Jobgether?

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Full Stack AI Engineer (Lisbon)
description:
The opportunity

Menhir is looking for a generalist full stack engineer to join our Lisbon headquarters and work on one of our venture development products: an AI-powered revenue recovery platform for healthcare clinics across Europe and the Americas. We believe the best person for this role is someone who can move across the entire stack, from infrastructure to product to AI, rather than a specialist in any single layer.

Our voice and WhatsApp AI agents recover lost patients for clinic groups, operating 24/7 with deep integration into clinic management systems. We already work with some of the largest healthcare groups in Europe, spanning hundreds of clinics across dental, veterinary, ophthalmology, and aesthetic medicine. Patient recovery is the wedge. We are building toward the payments and financing layer for healthcare.
Tasks

The role

You will be the first engineer based in Lisbon, working directly with the Menhir team that created the product. This is a generalist role by design: you will work across the full stack, from AI agent orchestration to the product interfaces our clinic partners and their patients use every day.

You will not be handed tickets. You will shape the product alongside the team, making decisions that define how it scales from hundreds of clinics to tens of thousands across multiple markets.

What you will work on: AI agent systems (orchestration, conversation flows, evaluation pipelines, prompt engineering, telephony and messaging APIs), product and dashboard (data visualizations, campaign management), new product development (patient-facing experiences, financial infrastructure), and integrations with clinic management systems across markets.
Requirements

What we are looking for

You build things. You have side projects, open source contributions, or products you shipped on your own. We care about what you have built, not where you studied.

You learn fast. You do not wait for documentation or a senior engineer to unblock you. You dig in and make it work.

You are a generalist. You can build a frontend, design an API, write a database query, and debug a deployment. At this stage, we need someone who can own problems end to end.

You have worked with LLMs. Hands-on experience building with language models, not just running prompts in a playground.

Python and TypeScript. Our core languages. You should be productive in both, or confident you can get there quickly.

You want ownership, not tickets. Ambiguity excites you, not paralyzes you.

0 to 3 years of experience. Or more, if you still have the hunger.

Bonus points for experience with real-time voice systems, Twilio, or WhatsApp Business API.

English is a must. Spanish or Portuguese are nice to haves.
Benefits

Competitive salary. Lisbon-based, working from Menhir's headquarters. You will collaborate with the team that built the product (Madrid and international) and be the technical anchor on-site.

How to apply

Send us a short note about what excites you about this role and a link to something you have built. We care far more about what you have shipped than where you went to school.

This position will work closely across the Regional and Global Product Leads, Services Business Sales Leads and other cross functional Teams.

Reporting directly to the Regional CA&E Rewards and Offers Product Management Lead, this individual will ensure card linked offers technologies maximize funding pools and facilitate sales customer dynamics.

Key Responsibilities

Act as Product Owner for card linked offers solutions to bring global product to the region, including use cases



-  Fuel and understand global roadmap
-  Support Product Localization and GTM
-  Support / co-lead operatable models
-  Lead process design improvements
-  Lead reporting modules developments and upgrades
-  Close involvement on pilot projects with customers

-  Training and educational sessions to Account Managers / Sales / Technical Support / Customer Care (as per Product Owner coordination)

-  A track record of delivering innovative, customer-centric solutions, understanding and implementing / contributing into the value proposition creation.
-  Experience launching and scaling products in dynamic environment.
-  Consultative mindset with the ability to craft compelling, customer-tailored narratives.
-  Understanding of consumer, industry, and market trends.
-  Creative problem solver with the ability to generate “out of the box” solutions and build alignment across diverse teams.

description:

PORTO

THE ROLE
As a Senior Data Analyst, you will join our Product Analytics team to champion data best practices and strengthen our technical foundations. You will deliver impactful insights regarding our tech products while playing a pivotal role in evolving our self-service data environment. By partnering closely with our Data Engineering team and power users across verticals, you will centralize business logic, optimize our data models, and ensure our analytics products remain performant, scalable, and governed.

What You'll Do



- Centralize Business Logic: Identify decentralized logic (such as complex cost calculations currently living inside Power BI semantic models) and push it upstream into centralized, well-documented data models
- Empower Self-Service: Provide our vertical power users with a clean, highly performant, and governed data foundation so they can confidently build the reports they need independently
- Champion Data Governance: Drive data governance efforts across our growing self-service ecosystem, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across the company
- Mentor & Elevate: Act as technical anchor for our team, mentoring on SQL optimization, dimensional modeling, and BI best practices

- Experienced Professional: You have 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, or Business Intelligence, with a strong track record of improving data infrastructure and performance
- Tech Savvy: You possess expert-level SQL skills and extensive experience with Power BI (including DAX optimization and semantic models) and cloud data platforms like Azure (particularly Databricks). - Architectural Thinker: You can easily identify bottlenecks in data pipelines or decentralized logic, and you take the initiative to design and implement efficient, scalable solutions
- Collaborative Mentor: You are a team player who enjoys collaborating closely with data team members and stakeholders
- Effective Communicator: You excel at translating complex technical concepts and governance standards to non-technical stakeholders and power users

title: Business Development Representative - Fully Remote Job
description:
About The Company

At Openprovider, we don’t just sell domains and SSL certificates - we power the digital presence of hundreds of thousands of entrepreneurs, web agencies, and enterprises across the globe. Our business is growing fast, and we’re transforming an entire industry that’s been standing still for too long.

Why work with us?

Every decision you make here affects the success of small businesses launching online shops, startups scaling globally, and enterprises managing thousands of digital assets. Our customers rely on us to keep their digital world running - and you’ll be part of making that possible.

A growth company

We’re on a mission to grow 30% year over year. That means new opportunities, new challenges, and a culture of ambition where your work directly contributes to measurable business success.

Technology that drives change

From automating millions of transactions to building AI-driven tools that make digital management easier, technology is at the heart of everything we do. We move fast, test often, and give our people the freedom to innovate.

A culture of ownership

We run Openprovider like entrepreneurs. Everyone has responsibility, freedom to act, and the expectation to make an impact. We operate on EOS principles and believe in transparency, accountability, and results.

An international team

With colleagues across Europe, Asia, and Latin America, you’ll collaborate with talented people who share a global mindset, high standards, and a passion for learning.

If you want to join a company where your work shapes the growth of thousands of businesses worldwide, and where your career can grow just as fast, Openprovider is the place.

About The Role

We're not actively hiring for this role right now, but we're always happy to connect with strong candidates and talk about what the future could look like.

We are looking for a Business Development Representative to accelerate new business growth through a balanced mix of outbound prospecting and inbound lead conversion. The Business Development Representative will proactively engage small to mid-size businesses and high-potential enterprise prospects, while also qualifying and transforming inbound inquiries into long-term, revenue-generating customers. This role strengthens Openprovider’s market presence by building a strong pipeline, closing high-value deals, and driving healthy margins through strategic outreach, consultative selling, and early-stage relationship nurturing, while ensuring smooth onboarding and strong customer adoption in the first 90 days. Build early customer success by successful onboarding (0-90 days) and hand over stable, engaged accounts to the AM team.

Key Responsibilities



- Strategic Prospecting & Lead Generation: Proactively identify and engage potential small-mid size and enterprise clients through outbound channels (LinkedIn, email campaigns, cold calling, industry events), focusing on Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) within assigned territories.
- Inbound Qualification & Response: Respond promptly to inbound leads, qualify them using sales frameworks, and ensure timely follow-up and conversion into meaningful pipeline opportunities.
- Discovery Meeting Booking & Follow-Through: Secure and conduct discovery calls with decision-makers, tailoring each interaction to uncover pain points and positioning Openprovider’s solutions as the ideal fit.
- Enterprise Deal Development: Build personalized outreach strategies and business cases for large accounts, managing long sales cycles while keeping momentum through stakeholder engagement and objection handling in Q3 so that we can start our outreaches on enterprise accounts in Q4 and build a pipeline for potential accounts to target in 2026 along with a joint partnership with marketing.
- Value-Based Sales Pitching & Proposals: Create compelling sales presentations and proposals that align Openprovider’s offerings with the strategic goals of enterprise prospects, ensuring clarity on value and ROI.
- Negotiation & Contract Finalization: Own the negotiation process with stakeholders across procurement, legal, and IT, working toward mutually beneficial terms while safeguarding margin expectations.
- Pipeline Management & Forecasting: Maintain a clean, organized pipeline in HubSpot with accurate forecasting, close dates, and next steps. Ensure all activity is logged and opportunities are correctly staged.
- Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams: Work closely with Marketing, Sales Enablement, Product, and Customer Success teams to align messaging, generate leads, and ensure a smooth post-sale handover.
- Market Intelligence Gathering: Continuously gather insights on competitor activity, market shifts, customer feedback, and industry trends; use this knowledge to adapt sales strategies and inform leadership.
- Revenue & Margin Accountability: Consistently meet or exceed assigned quarterly revenue targets and margin expectations by focusing on high-value deals and enterprise-level partnerships.
- 0–90 Days Customer Management: Own the full customer journey for the first 90 days by driving successful onboarding, ensuring adoption and first value, and acting as the single point of contact for all queries. Once customers are fully stabilized and activated, transition them smoothly to the Account Management team with a complete handover.

What We Are Looking For



- Sales Expertise: Proven ability to meet or exceed sales targets in a tech-driven environment.
- Market Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of the EU, APAC and North American markets.
- Negotiation & Closing Skills: Strong negotiation skills with a track record of successfully closing high-value deals with Mid-Market and Enterprise companies
- Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of presenting complex tech solutions in a clear and persuasive manner.
- Relationship Management: Ability to build and nurture long-term professional relationships with clients.
- Problem-Solving: Proactive and creative in solving client problems using tech solutions.
- CRM Proficiency: Experience using CRM software (Hubspot) to manage leads, forecast sales, and report on progress.

Soft skills:



- Enthusiastic: ready to tackle this market, with a passion for sales 
- Resilience: because they will be a lot of NO before a YES
- Good listener: letting the customer talk by asking the right questions 
- Empathy: being able to put yourself in the shoes of the resellers and help to tackle their everyday problems. 
- Have the courage: Do not be afraid to ask
- Great communication skills in English, verbal and written

What We Offer



- 100% Remote Work Work from anywhere in the world: we’re a fully remote company with no mandatory office presence.
- ⏰ Flexible Working Hours Organize your schedule in a way that works best for you and your productivity.
- Generous Time Off Enjoy 31 working days of PTO, plus 5 company-wide public holidays.
- Quarterly & Annual Reviews Transparent performance conversations with clear opportunities to grow, learn, and progress in your career.
- Global Team Culture Collaborate with open-minded colleagues from 25+ countries in a diverse and inclusive environment.
- ☕ Regular Online Social Activities Virtual coffee breaks, online games, meetups, and company gatherings help us stay connected across borders.
- Learning & Growth Opportunities Access internal workshops, cross-team projects, and knowledge-sharing sessions to continuously develop your skills.
- Modern Remote Workplace We are an ISO 27001-certified organization, maintaining high standards of security and professionalism in everything we do.
- Tools That Empower You We provide access to modern collaboration platforms and tools that make remote teamwork smooth and effective.
- AI Subscription (Claude) Get access to advanced AI tools to support your productivity and creativity.
- Supportive Environment We value trust, transparency, and wellbeing, because happy people build better products.

About Us

Most resellers spend too much money and time on domains. With Openprovider and our Membership program, you can buy, renew, and transfer domains at cost price on one platform to become a more successful and profitable reseller.

We are a rapidly-growing, ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology scale-up founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. We understand the frustrations of wasting hours searching for new domains at fair prices; being hit by unexpected renewal costs after the first year; and losing customers because you can’t offer attractive bundles.

That’s why we built a platform to easily manage operations for over 1,900 domain extensions. We were the first to offer a Membership Program to get the domains you need at cost price, and we've been helping clients sell millions of domains for more than 20 years.

We have been fully remote since 2020, and our team has only expanded since then. Our team currently consists of 110+ employees, who are spread across 25+ different countries and 4 different continents. We are proud of our fun and diverse team and regularly connect with each other through online and offline events.
