title: Internship Programme 2027: Product Owner (UX)
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Internship Programme

Our Internship Programme is designed for ambitious students who want to make their summer count. Over 8–10 paid weeks, you’ll work on real projects, tackle meaningful challenges, and develop your skills alongside industry experts. It’s an opportunity to learn, innovate, and build a solid foundation for your career.

Top performers may be offered a place on our Graduate Programme the following year, giving you the opportunity to return and continue your journey at Revolut.

About The Role

The Product team shapes the experiences that power Revolut. They turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions — collaborating across design, engineering, and data to build features our customers love.

We’re looking for Product Owner Interns (UX) who are curious, analytical, and passionate about user experience. You'll learn how to guide collaboration and create products used worldwide.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

Join us from anywhere

The Internship Programme is open to international applicants ready to relocate to one of our tech hubs in Poland, Portugal, the UAE, or the UK. We’ll support you with visa assistance, travel costs, and accommodation (conditions apply). You’ll be expected to spend around 3 days per week in the office (where role and location allow).

Key dates



- Applications: open from May 2026
- Recruitment process: July–December 2026
- Programme start: June / July 2027

Roles are filled on a rolling basis — apply early.

What You'll Be Doing



- Supporting senior Product Owners with product strategy, roadmaps, and feature planning
- Gathering and analysing data, including user feedback and market insights, to inform decisions
- Collaborating with Design, Engineering, and Operations to deliver initiatives from concept to launch
- Creating clear product requirements and ensuring smooth implementation
- Conducting user testing and iterating on features based on results
- Tracking progress, sharing updates with global teams, and presenting outcomes
- Receiving regular feedback to accelerate your development

What You'll Need



- To be in your penultimate year of a bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., computer science, maths, physics, economics, or another STEM subject), graduating in 2028
- A predicted or achieved first-class degree (or equivalent grade)
- Great analytical, problem-solving, and organisational skills
- Clear communication and interpersonal skills
- Passion for technology, innovation, and customer experience
- The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, diverse environment
- Fluency in English
- Close attention to detail
- Full-time availability for summer 2027
- The ability to attend a Revolut office in your country of employment at least 3 days per week (this is a hybrid role)

Nice to have



- Fluency in other languages
- Experience as an entrepreneur or working in a startup

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.



-  Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
-  Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

description:
#CapitalMarkets #EquityDerivatives #Flow #StructuredProducts #InstitutionalClients #SecondaryMarkets

About The Job



- The Valuation Analyst position in Lisbon focuses on dealing with daily valuations which are not only a crucial element for our clients and for the bank’s risk management (via collateral) but are also the basis for prices on secondary trades
- The Valuation Analyst role isn’t about pricing clients’ requests for quote (RFQ), however, it involves a type of ad-hoc decision-making that directly impacts BNP Paribas’ (BNPP) PNL, while also demanding synthesis and optimization capabilities

Your Main Activities Are



- Provide clients with high-quality, accurate valuations
- Take ownership of the valuation chain including its impact on secondary trades
- Address requests pertaining to valuations, from client service, sales or collateral management
- Conduct deep-dives into specific valuations to provide performance analysis
- Participate in the development and scalability of the platform to improve client satisfaction, by enhancing the quality, speed and accuracy of valuations

Profile And Skills To Success



- Master Degree in Finance or Similar
- Fluent in English
- Client‑focused mindset
- Ability to effectively deliver projects
- Sound decision‑making skills under pressure
- Risk‑aware approach to daily tasks
- Solid knowledge of equity derivatives and structured products
- Ability to write code and understand system architecture and interdependencies

About The Team



- Within Global Equities & Commodity Derivatives department, SCOPE Trading (Secondary Client Offer & Post Trade) is a global team in charge of providing a market on secondary trades on exotic products and facilitating various aspects of BNPP’s secondary market, in particular providing our clients with the most accurate daily valuations on the entire range of products (flow and exotics) traded with them, as well as supporting them with performance explanations on their trades
- SCOPE occupies a unique and strategic position dealing with the entire gamut of products BNPP’s EQD department has to offer, with constant interactions with Sales and Traders
- Global Markets, the capital markets division of BNP Paribas' Corporate & Institutional Banking, is a powerhouse delivering top-tier solutions across asset classes. Our Portugal Platform (Porto and Lisbon) stands as a major European HUB and a unique player in the country, boasting a wide range of Front Office roles and services – Trading, Sales, Research, Structuring, Quants & Engineering, Business Dev and Support, Marketing & Client Support, Risk Management, Data Analytics and Machine Learning. With rapid growth and ambitions to make a global impact, we offer numerous short and long-term opportunities

Get a glimpse into our world- Check out our Global Markets Portugal webpage

Why joining BNP Paribas? 



- Leading banking institution

Leading player in banking and financial services in Europe, BNP Paribas operates in 64 countries and has nearly 178,000 employees, including more than 144,000 in Europe



- International reach 

The Group holds key positions in several areas of banking and financial services that are structured around three operating divisions:



- Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) connects companies needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities division that offers tailored financial solutions for corporate and institutional clients.
- Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS) brings together all our commercial banks and several specialised businesses
- Investment & Protection Services (IPS) combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real estate including specialised businesses offering a wide range of savings, investment and protection services
- Our presence in Portugal

In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.220 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 centres of expertise providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates.



- Diversity and Inclusion commitment 

BNP Paribas ´ambition Is To Cultivate An Open And Responsive Environment For All That Encourages Collaboration And Interaction. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As Part Of Our Local Corporate And Social Responsibility – Diversity & Inclusion Strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal Is Committed To



- Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees
- Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard.

To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society.



- Remote Working Conditions

At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices.



- Commitment towards work/life balance

Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life.

title: Procurement Team leader
description:
Carrier is the leading worldwide provider of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC), refrigeration, fire, security, and cold chain solutions. We invented the modern air conditioning, and our team of pioneers and innovators have a long history of developing new technologies.

Addvolt, now part of Carrier, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, delivers advanced electrification technology, integrated power management and power electronics capabilities for transport refrigeration and auxiliary systems.  Driving innovation in the electrification and decarbonization of onboard systems for refrigerated trailers, trucks, vans and containers, Addvolt empowers fleets to avoid fuel usage, reduce major emissions and operate efficiently at a remarkably low noise level. By combining Addvolt’s innovative power solutions with Carrier Transicold’s expertise in transport refrigeration, we are enhancing the value we deliver to fleets, original equipment manufacturers and logistics operators worldwide. Together with Carrier, we are accelerating the transition to a more sustainable, efficient and intelligent cold chain.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Procurement Team Leader (he/she) to join the Operations Team in Porto.

The candidate must be highly organized, proactive and confident in Vendor management and negotiation, with a strong focus on ensuring stable, efficient and cost-effective Procurement operations.

This role requires close collaboration with Planning, Warehouse & Logistics, Engineering and Quality Teams, while also leading Procurement activities and driving continuous improvement across the function.

As Procurement Team Leader You Will



- Lead and oversee the full Procurement process, ensuring competitive costs, reliable deliveries and strong Vendor performance aligned with Organizational objectives.
- Negotiate, manage and ensure compliance with Vendor contracts, including pricing agreements, service levels, confidentiality clauses, Organizational and regulatory requirements, in coordination with Legal and internal stakeholders.
- Monitor performance indicators (KPIs) related to Procurement activities, identifying opportunities for improvement and taking corrective actions, when necessary.
- Ensure effective cross-functional alignment with Planning and Warehouse & Logistics Teams to guarantee material availability, minimizing shortages and excess inventory.
- Collaborate closely with Engineering Team on technical sourcing, specifications and supplier selection.
- Collaborate closely with PLM Team on change management processes (ECR/ECN).
- Work with the Quality Team to manage Vendor-related non-conformities, claims, PPAP requirements, audits and other Vendor development initiatives.
- Support inventory optimization by supervising MOQs, Lead Times, and safety stock parameters.
- Supervise accurate and updated data in the ERP (pricing, lead times, Vendor information, purchasing terms).
- Provide strategic feedback and reporting to the Management Team.
- Train, coach, and develop Team Members to improve skills and performance.
- Conduct performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to Team Members.
- Provide strategic feedback and reporting to the Management Team.

Candidate Values And Qualifications

Values & Mindset



- Share Addvolt / Carrier values – Respect, Integrity, Inclusion, Innovation & Excellence.

Qualifications



- Proven experience in Procurement, Supply Chain or related operations (minimum 3–5 years preferred).
- Proficiency with ERP systems, ideally Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, SAP, or similar platforms.
- Knowledge of inventory management principles and their impact on purchasing decisions.
- Strong understanding of Procurement best practices, including Vendor selection, negotiation, contract management, and cost optimization.
- Experience managing Vendor relationships, including performance monitoring, issue resolution, and service-level improvement.
- Flexible and open to change, committed to design and implement innovative Procurement processes and strategies.
- Highly autonomous and critically minded, with a strong drive for continuous improvement.
- Ability to lead cross-functional collaboration with several Teams, ensuring material availability and cost efficiency.
- Ability to work under pressure, prioritize effectively and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent leadership, communication and interpersonal skills.
- Proficiency in tools such as Excel, Power BI, PowerApps, or similar is a plus.
- Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory; additional languages are an advantage.

WHY ADDVOLT



- Addvolt is poised for explosive growth in the emerging intelligent transportation space;
- We will give you all the opportunities to shine and exceed your expectations.
- To be part of an ever-growing team where your work can have a huge impact.
- Work towards a greener and more sustainable future by promoting quieter and cleaner transportation.
- Flexible working hours.

Our Commitment

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity, and passion of our employees. We provide a work environment that fosters innovation, collaboration, and growth, attracting and retaining the best talent. Diversity, inclusion, and employee engagement are central to our culture. We offer enriching career opportunities, professional development programs, and continuous feedback to help you succeed.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!

Conducting business for more than 45 years, Pluxee is committed to creating a positive impact on local communities, supporting well-being at work for employees, and protecting the planet.


🚀 Your next challenge
Pluxee is looking for a hands-on and versatile Marketing Content & Engagement Lead to strengthen our Marketing team and drive impactful content, campaigns, and stakeholder engagement across our B2B2C ecosystem.
In this role, you will be responsible for executing and optimizing digital content across our website (EDDiE CMS) and CRM (HubSpot), while leading multi-channel engagement initiatives targeting clients, merchants, and consumers.
You will play a key role in bringing our value proposition to life through high-quality content, lifecycle campaigns, and stakeholder-focused projects. If you enjoy combining creativity with execution, working cross-functionally, and delivering measurable marketing impact, this role is for you.


💡 About You
You are a proactive and detail-oriented marketing professional with 3–5+ years of experience in digital marketing, content management, and campaign execution — ideally in a B2B or B2B2C environment.
You are comfortable managing multiple channels and formats, from websites and CRM campaigns to marketing assets and events. You combine strong execution skills with a good understanding of engagement strategies and stakeholder needs.
You enjoy working closely with Sales, CX, Product, and external partners, ensuring that marketing initiatives are aligned, effective, and delivered on time.


✅ Key Responsibilities


Content Management (Website & CRM)
• Own and execute content implementation on EDDiE CMS (website) and HubSpot.
• Create and update blog pages, product pages, landing pages, and conversion points.
• Build and optimize forms and user journeys to maximize engagement and lead conversion.
• Ensure consistency, accuracy, and alignment of content with brand and product positioning.


CRM & Engagement Campaigns
• Design and execute email, SMS, and lifecycle campaigns for key stakeholders (clients, merchants, and consumers).
• Support acquisition, onboarding, engagement, and retention initiatives through targeted communications.
• Collaborate with Sales and CX to align campaigns with business priorities and customer journeys.
• Monitor and optimize campaign performance (open rates, CTR, conversion).
Media Relations & Events

title: New Business Account Executive - Italian speakers - Malta market (Portugal)
description:
About Revolut
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.
As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role
Our Sales team powers customer growth around the world. From prospecting to acquisition and activation, they own their market segments, solve complex problems, and help more customers discover the value of Revolut with a sharp, solution-oriented approach.
We’re looking for an Account Executive to provide an excellent experience for our new business customers. You'll effectively identify opportunities, conduct outreach, and drive deals through the funnel, owning closing and end-to-end activation.
If you’re a motivated individual who enjoys a challenge and acts with integrity at all times, we’d love to hear from you.


What you'll be doing

- Outreaching prospects across multiple touch points and channels, with an emphasis on cold-calling
- Developing and executing a robust lead-sourcing strategy by identifying key verticals, diversifying your prospects base, and maintaining consistent activity levels
- Building and managing your own pipeline, from prospecting to closing and account management, maximising adoption and upsell/cross-sell opportunities
- Liaising customer relationships with Revolut internal stakeholders to ensure a smooth experience, from getting started to daily usage
- Being autonomous to effectively balance your time (prospect vs. close vs. upsell), activate internal resources, and engage your team
- Using solution-based selling to understand customer needs and communicate the value proposition
- Becoming a product expert on Revolut Business, its market positioning, and the solutions it offers, backed by relevant, compelling case studies


What you'll need

- Fluency in English and Italian
- 1+ years of demonstrable commercial experience, particularly in outbound sales and prospecting
- Excellent communication skills and articulation over the phone
- Impeccable literacy skills (email, LinkedIn outreach)
- A keen interest in launching a career in a high-performing sales culture
- Proven determination and accountability to succeed in a fast-paced environment
- A willingness to help outside of your main job to make sure customers have a great experience
- Curiosity and an attitude of a quick data-oriented learner who thrives in a dynamic, collaborative environment
- Effective time management and organisation skills to balance customer engagement, deal closing, and CRM administration


Nice to have



- A degree in finance or a business-related subject
- An entrepreneurial, problem-solving mindset
- To be a deal closer with a positive, creative, and innovative attitude
- Experience in a reputable startup
- Impressive cross-functional project management skills
- To be comfortable in a complex selling environment with the ability to communicate with decision makers at many levels

- Remote role with flexibility and autonomy.

- A dynamic and entrepreneurial environment inside a growing international group.
- Strong exposure to business development, partnerships, and market expansion.

- This an hybrid position.

title: Strategic Portfolio Manager AI
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a member of our Digital Core team, you own and evolve our central AI portfolio of products, services, and use cases, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and value creation. You establish and continuously enhance portfolio-level reporting, frameworks, and methodologies to drive transparency and execution excellence. Working closely with stakeholders across our business areas and functions, you align AI demand and drive awareness of AI enterprise capabilities for successful implementation in business use cases. In collaboration with our management team, you communicate portfolio progress and impact to senior stakeholders. You also lead workshops and awareness sessions with teams across Siemens Energy and our external partner ecosystem.

How You’ll Make An Impact



- Define, maintain, and continuously evolve the central AI portfolio (products, services, use cases) to ensure strategic alignment with company priorities and business value creation
- Establish portfolio-level reporting on progress, impact, and outcomes, and provide clear visibility of delivery status, dependencies, risks, and achievements across all AI initiatives.
- Continuously improve AI service delivery frameworks, methodologies, and project management practices to enable scalable, efficient, and high-quality execution
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders across business areas and functions, align AI demand with central capabilities and ensure impactful delivery
- Facilitate workshops, AI discovery and awareness sessions to help identify high-value AI opportunities and strengthen AI adoption across the organization


What You Bring



- At least 8 years of proven experience managing complex digital or technology portfolios, including roadmap planning, structured prioritization frameworks, and measurable value tracking
- Strong strategic planning skills and experience in establishing governance structures, KPIs, and continuous improvement mechanisms in agile and hybrid delivery environments
- Solid understanding of AI/ML concepts and their application in industrial environments, with the ability to effectively bridge business needs and technical perspectives
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex topics into clear business language, engage senior stakeholders, and drive alignment across diverse organizational units.
- Strong interpersonal, storytelling, and change management skills and ability to operate effectively in a multidisciplinary, multinational, global environment including external partners


About The Team

The Digital Core AI organization has been established and designed to help Siemens Energy achieve its mission by leveraging powerful AI capabilities to support customers in transitioning to a more sustainable world, by using innovative technologies and bringing ideas into reality.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than ~100,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.

Our cross-border team is committed to redefining the energy sector by exploring new possibilities to achieve balanced, reliable, and affordable energy solutions. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same! Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is motivated by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits



- In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
- We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
- We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
- The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
- In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

Match Profiler is an Information Systems consultancy with over 25 years of experience in the national and international technology market.
 We believe in challenging and motivating projects, driven by multidisciplinary and agile teams - and we are looking for those who want to grow with us.
 With a close-knit approach, we develop solutions that drive business growth with innovation, trust and security. 🔐
 If you aspire to a career that challenges you daily and allows you to make a real impact - this opportunity is for you.


We are currently strengthening the team of one of our clients with the following profile:
.NET Tech Lead – Hybrid (Lisbon) 💻🚀


This opportunity is ideal for a hands-on technical leader who enjoys mentoring teams, driving architectural decisions and working across the full stack.
What we are looking for:


Hard skills

- Lead the design, development and deployment of fullstack applications using .NET Framework / .NET Core and modern UI frameworks 💻
- Provide technical leadership and mentorship, promoting best practices in coding, architecture and DevOps 👥
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable architectures and microservices-based solutions ⚙️
- Develop and maintain REST APIs, ensuring seamless integration across systems 🔗
- Work with DXP/CMS platforms such as Optimizely, Umbraco or similar
- Design, manage and optimize SQL and NoSQL databases for performance and scalability 📊
- Use DevOps tools (GitHub workflows & actions) to streamline CI/CD processes 🔄
- Drive continuous improvement by staying up to date with latest technologies and trends


Must-Have Qualifications

- Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics or similar 🎓
- +8 years of experience as a C# .NET Developer (.NET Framework / .NET Core)
- Hands-on experience with DXP/CMS platforms (Optimizely, Umbraco, or equivalent)
- Strong knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases
- Solid experience in REST API development
- Proven experience with React and Next.js (mandatory) ⚛️
- Strong technical leadership experience, including architecture decisions and team guidance (mandatory)
- Experience with DevOps practices and tools, including GitHub workflows
- Background in designing scalable architectures and microservices
- Engineering mindset focused on performance, problem-solving and system thinking
- English level B2 or higher
- Availability for hybrid work (2x/week in Lisbon) 📍


Nice-to-Have Qualifications

- Experience with Azure or other cloud platforms ☁️
- Experience with ASP.NET Core / Web API


Soft skills

- Strong leadership and communication skills
- Strategic thinking and decision-making ability 🎯
- Proactive mindset and ownership
- Team player with mentoring spirit 🤝


What we have to offer

- Careful onboarding and close support from day one ✅
- Continuous feedback aligned with your professional goals 📈
- A collaborative and knowledge-driven environment
- Opportunity to lead impactful and innovative projects 🚀
- Access to exclusive partnerships and benefits (health, travel, culture and more)
- Team events and initiatives that strengthen our culture 🎉


📩 To apply, please send your CV to ana.simoes@m-profiler.pt

title: Software Engineer (.NET)
description:
Who are we:
Neotalent Conclusion is one of the leading Iberian specialists providing services in Information Technology and Engineering services. As part of the Netherlands-based organization Conclusion, which has an ecosystem of over 25 companies and 3,600 employees, we are focused on increasing the technological capacity of our clients and the digital transformation of their application ecosystems.
We are talent specialists, attracting the best people and combining them with the needs of the most ambitious projects, at the right time. Our success comes from our investments in innovation, our focus on results, and, above all, the guarantee that our people will have happy and rewarding careers.
With over 25 years of solid experience, Neotalent Conclusion has established its presence in key locations, including Lisbon, Porto, and Madrid. The company currently has more than 950 professionals in the different areas in which it operates.
Neotalent, the responsive people.
Find out more about us at www.neotalent.pt.




Role Overview:
We are looking for a Software Engineer (.NET) to join one of our biggest clients, a leading European digital marketplace in the automotive sector, operating high-volume real-time auction platforms across multiple markets.
If you are looking for an opportunity to contribute to scalable, real-time systems, grow within a collaborative and innovative team, and work with modern distributed architectures, this is the ideal project for your career.
Come energize your future with us!
Offices in Coimbra (hybrid – once a month)


What you will do:
• Contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of .NET applications and services
• Build and maintain features within a microservices and distributed systems environment
• Support real-time data processing and bid communication flows across regions
• Write clean, maintainable, and testable code while participating in code reviews


What you are like:
• Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
• 4+ years of experience in software engineering
• Solid experience with C# and .NET Core /.NET 6+
• Understanding of web technologies (REST APIs, HTTP, JSON) and Agile methodologies
• Knowledge of databases (relational; NoSQL is a plus), cloud environments (Azure/AWS), and interest in distributed systems concepts (e.g., scalability, event-driven architecture, CI/CD)


Why join us:
• Work on challenging projects for big clients
• Learn more about emerging technologies
• Possibility of working remotely
• Design your career plan
• Access to continuous training and certifications
• Evolve through our internal mobility program
• … and much more!

title: Business Manager
description:
Join Ifthenpay – Shape the Future of Payments
Are you ambitious, driven, and ready to grow fast? Do you want more than just a job — a real opportunity to build something, lead, and make an impact?


At Ifthenpay, we’re not just a payment provider — we’re a fast-growing, innovative company powering solutions in DIGITAL PAYMENTS ECOSYSTEM. Our young, dynamic team is scaling, and we’re looking for the next generation of leaders to grow with us.


Who We’re Looking For
We’re searching for a high-potential professional who, within 1–2 years, will be ready to take ownership of a business line — driving growth, shaping strategy, and leading a team.
This is not just a role. This is a career launchpad into leadership.




🔥 What You’ll Do

- Lead and grow a high-performing team
- Take ownership of a rapidly scaling business area
- Drive business growth, expansion, and strategic initiatives
- Work closely with leadership to shape the future of Ifthenpay
- Collaborate with multiple departments (commercial, tech, compliance, etc.)

- Bring an entrepreneurial mindset to everything you do


🎯 What We Expect

- A natural leader with a hands-on, entrepreneurial attitude
- Strong ability to think analytically and logically
- Confidence working with numbers and financial KPIs
- Precision, curiosity, and a drive to improve constantly


💼 Your Experience

- 4–7 years of professional experience
- At least 1–2 years in a managerial role (leading people/teams)
- Background in:
- Payments, Fintech or Financial Services (preferred)
- Transactional businesses
- SaaS
- Vertical market software
- Strong understanding of financial metrics and business performance


📍 Location

- Porto (and surrounding area)
- Lisbon (and surrounding area)


🌟 Why Join Ifthenpay?

- Be part of a young, energetic, and fast-growing team
- Get a real path to leadership — not in 10 years, but in 1–2
- Work in a company that invests in your growth
- Build skills that will allow you to run your own business line in the future


🚀 Ready to Grow Fast?
If you’re hungry to learn, eager to lead, and ready to take responsibility early in your career — we want to hear from you.


Apply now and grow into the leader you’re meant to be.

title: Recruitment Transversal Support Trainee
description:
About The Job



- To actively contributing to the pursuing of BNP Paribas' Recruitment strategy and growth for Portugal. To ensure an effective Recruitment delivery to the Group's Business Areas at local level, by sourcing and assessing the right talent in the shortest period possible, while managing relationships with both internal and external stakeholders (Hiring Managers and Candidates), acting as advisory partner and respecting the highest ethical and conduct standards at all moments

Your Main Activities Are



- Importing and exporting information from Recruitment requests to the system
- Reviewing and publishing job adverts
- Taking part of transversal Recruitment projects and processes (Referral Programme, Inclusive Recruitment and others)
- Supporting the Recruitment team in tools and daily tasks
- Participating in all team-bonding activities
- Supporting the full cycle of Recruitment

Profile And Skills To Success



- Masters degree in Social Sciences, Human Resources or related fields
- Knowledge of Human Resources
- Knowledge of Assessment/evaluation
- Fluency in English is required
- Ability to collaborate/Teamwork
- Communication skills - oral & written
- Ability to develop and leverage on networks 

Why joining BNP Paribas? 

BNP Paribas, The European Leader In Banking And Financial Services In Europe, Operates In 64 Countries And Has Nearly 180,000 Employees. The Group Is Structured Around Three Operating Divisions. Its Business Lines Cooperate Closely, As Part Of Our Integrated Model, To Meet The Needs Of All Our Clients In a Coordinated Manner



- Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities;
- Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses;
- Investment & Protection Services (IPS), combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate.

Our presence in Portugal

In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centres providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates.

Diversity and Inclusion Commitment

BNP Paribas´ Ambition Is To Cultivate An Open And Responsive Environment For All That Encourages Collaboration And Interaction. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As Part Of Our Local Corporate And Social Responsibility - Diversity & Inclusion Strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal Is Committed To



- Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees;
- Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard.

To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society.

Remote Working Conditions

At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices.

Commitment towards work/life balance

Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life.

To find out more on why you should join BNP Paribas please read our Employee Value Proposition and our Career path page.



-  Please note that only applications submitted in English will be considered.
-  In case you are selected for this role, further documentation will be requested to support your hiring process.

Formação em Engenharia (Química, Materiais, Civil ou similar)
Inglês técnico (obrigatório)
Conhecimento de normas e regulamentação da construção (valorizado)
Bons conhecimentos de ferramentas informáticas
Perfil analítico, organizado e com sentido de responsabilidade


Oferta:
Contrato sem termo (efetivo)
Subsídio de Alimentação: 10,46€ por dia (em cartão)
Seguro de saúde
Integração numa empresa em forte crescimento e expansão
Oportunidade de evolução e crescimento interno
Projeto com forte componente técnica e de desenvolvimento profissional


Se procuras uma oportunidade para crescer numa área técnica e em contacto com normas e certificação de produto, esta pode ser a tua próxima etapa.
